The body returns 0xffffffff when the record argument is null. Otherwise it resolves the record pointer, then the indexed helper reads byte record+0x48+index for low-byte indices 0..5 and returns 0xff outside that range. The caller passes a 32-bit index. The proposed 0xff wording omitted the distinct 32-bit null sentinel, so this corrected name preserves the indexed lookup and generic failure behavior without conflating the two sentinel values.
